statement: A source-backed TR compatibility prototype must distinguish Bluetooth-bus PID/name from real built-in MP presence, answer status/ACK and register reads consistently, switch inactive A600 and mapped A400 identities across modes 04/05/07, and deliver correctly tagged gyro and child frames. Full physical TR inactive six-byte identity, exact FE, genuine calibration CRC, F6/F7/40 and challenge contents remain unmeasured. Existing optional F6 mirror and A40040 child calibration shims apply only with active MP+downstream for Dolphin, using caller-imported blocks; values without approved compat profile or caller data remain unserved.

applicability.revision: TR/Gen 2 pinned consumer paths; no retail or firmware revision measured
applicability.scope: evidence_role: device. Linux core 411-557, Dolphin CI 543-657, Cemu provider 275-380, wiiuse 45-166, Dolphin MP emulation 95-154. Conditional compatibility inference, not physical measurement. All acceptance/physical experiments explicitly not run.
